title: Tap2Listen: Instant Target Switching for Streaming Audio-Visual Speaker Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.36643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AV-TSE) uses a target speaker's face to extract the speaker's speech from an input audio mixture in real time. However, existing systems fix the target speaker for an entire clip, while conversation demands frequent and immediate target switches. To address this problem, we propose Tap2Listen, a streaming AV-TSE model designed for instant response to target switches. The model separates computation by modality: the target-agnostic audio encoder processes only the mixture, while the target-specific visual cues of the selected face condition only the decoder. A switch requires only a 0.12ms re-projection and takes effect immediately. We also design component-wise losses: a prediction loss for the encoder and a supervised extraction loss for the decoder. For evaluation, we measure how quickly output quality recovers after a switch. On the standard LRS3-2mix test set, Tap2Listen improves SI

translated_title: Tap2Listen：面向流式音视频说话人提取的即时目标切换
translated_abstract: 流式音视频目标说话人提取（AV-TSE）利用目标说话人的面部信息，从输入的混合音频中实时提取该说话人的语音。然而，现有系统在整个音频片段中固定目标说话人，而对话场景需要频繁且即时地进行目标切换。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Tap2Listen，一个专为即时响应目标切换而设计的流式AV-TSE模型。该模型按模态分离计算：与目标无关的音频编码器仅处理混合音频，而被选中目标面部的视觉线索仅对解码器进行条件化控制。一次切换仅需0.12ms的重投影即可立即生效。我们还设计了组件级的损失函数：编码器的预测损失和解码器的监督提取损失。在评估方面，我们衡量切换后输出质量恢复的速度。在标准的LRS3-2mix测试集上，Tap2Listen提升了SI（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出Tap2Listen流式音视频说话人提取模型，通过按模态分离计算架构，将目标切换开销降至仅需0.12ms的重投影，实现了对话场景下的即时目标切换。
en_tdlr: Tap2Listen enables instant target switching in streaming audio-visual speaker extraction by separating computation by modality, reducing each switch to a 0.12ms re-projection for real-time conversational use.
